post:
  operationId: post.workspaces.scheduling.assignments
  summary: Create scheduling assignment (PHANTOM PATH)
  x-verification-status: LIVE-OVERRIDE
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-030000-post.workspaces.scheduling.assignments-path-probe.json
  x-notes: |
    PHANTOM: GET /workspaces/{wId}/scheduling/assignments returns 404 'No static resource'
    confirming path is absent live (Spring-MVC: 404=absent, 405=exists/wrong-method).
    Source code audit: clockify_scheduling_assignments_create uses POST
    /workspaces/{wId}/scheduling/assignments/recurring (scheduling.go line 465).
    Our OpenAPI spec lists the bare /scheduling/assignments path as ours-source-only,
    which is incorrect — the real create path is /scheduling/assignments/recurring.
    Recommend: remove this phantom entry from spec, add /scheduling/assignments/recurring
    as the correct create path.
  x-truth-iter: iter19
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
  responses:
    '404':
      description: Path absent — No static resource (Spring-MVC 404).
endpoints.notes: DISCREPANCY FOUND. Bare /scheduling/assignments path is phantom — does not exist live. Actual create endpoint is /scheduling/assignments/recurring. Our spec needs correction.
